n-k-k5-01.s.s3.modelNote.2: Which practice times pass every rule?
n-k-k5-01.title: Notice support Minseo?
n-k-k5-01.goal: Check friend claim against every condition in notice, no be only first one, and explain result in Korean.
n-k-k5-01.material:
Shop online notice and message from friend Minseo. Today na July 12.

[여름맞이 이벤트 안내]
- 기간: 7월 1일 ~ 7월 15일
- 이벤트 기간에 3만 원 이상 사시면 배송비가 무료입니다.
- 제주·도서산간 지역은 무료 배송 대상이 아닙니다. (배송비 3,000원)
- 할인 쿠폰은 한 번만 쓸 수 있습니다.

민서의 문자: ‘나 어제 4만 원어치 샀어! 배송비 무료래. 제주도에 계신 우리 할머니 댁으로 보냈는데 잘됐지?’
n-k-k5-01.thinking.2: Notice rule wey exclude some areas
n-k-k5-01.prereq.0: Fit read 이상, 제외, -(으)면 and short notices
n-k-k5-01.prereq.1: Know numbers like 만 원 and 삼천 원
n-k-k5-01.prereq.2: Know 도서산간 = remote islands and mountain areas
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.prompt: To decide whether Minseo claim true, which notice lines must you compare with her message? Choose all wey matter.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.0: Which facts in Minseo message notice talk about? Find one notice line for each.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.hint.1: For each notice line ask: e set condition for free delivery?
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.r.a: Coupon rule about discount. Minseo claim about delivery fee, so this line no decide am.
n-k-k5-01.s.s1.explain: Her claim get three parts: when she buy (event period), amount (30,000 won or more), and delivery place (area rule). Each part match one line; coupon no concern delivery.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.prompt: Notice support Minseo claim say delivery free?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.0: Check each notice condition one at a time against her message.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.hint.1: Which condition you never check against her message?
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.a: Yes, but only if she also use the one-time discount coupon.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.a: Coupon separate offer; e no be condition for free delivery.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.b: Cannot tell, because only Minseo know how much she really pay.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.b: Amount dey in her message, and notice name excluded regions, so decision possible.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.c: Yes. She buy for 40,000 won during event, so delivery free.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.r.c: She check date and amount but stop there. Notice get one more condition about where parcel go.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.o.d: No. Notice no offer free delivery to the area she send am.
n-k-k5-01.s.s2.explain: Free delivery need event period AND 30,000 won or more AND delivery place not excluded. Minseo meet first two, but notice exclude 제주·도서산간. Meeting first condition no make whole claim true.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.prompt: Reply Minseo in friendly Korean (-요). Say wetin you think about delivery fee and give reason from notice. English okay if stuck.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.0: Start with place, then say what notice say about that place.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.hint.1: End with wetin Minseo suppose expect to pay.
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: I base am on notice, no be only my guess?
n-k-k5-01.s.s3.model.2: I think e no free: notice say Jeju no included, so there fit be 3,000 won fee.

n-k-k5-03.title: Reservation wey meet every rule
n-k-k5-03.topic: several conditions at once, one hidden in wording
n-k-k5-03.goal: Turn notice with negative rule into exact conditions, find different reservations wey meet all, and report one in Korean.
n-k-k5-03.material:
You book museum workshop for family. Museum notice and aunt text:

[가족 체험 예약 안내]
- 요금: 어른 1명 8,000원, 어린이 1명 5,000원
- 한 번에 4명 이상 6명 이하까지 예약할 수 있습니다.
- 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.
- 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다.

이모 문자: ‘예산은 4만 원까지예요.’
n-k-k5-03.thinking.0: Read negative rule correctly (적으면 안 되다)
n-k-k5-03.prereq.0: Know numbers, 명, 원 and 이상 / 이하
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.prompt: Notice say ‘어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다.’ Which reservations this rule allow?
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.0: Turn rule into adult rule: ‘adults must not be ... than children.’
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.hint.1: Write rule comparing adult and child counts, then test unequal and equal amounts.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.a: Exactly same number of adults and children, no other mix.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.a: Rule only forbid FEWER adults. More adults okay too.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.b: Same number adults and children, or more adults than children.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.c: More adults than children; same number no allowed.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.r.c: Equal numbers no be ‘fewer adults,’ so dem allowed.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.o.d: More children than adults; same number no allowed.
n-k-k5-03.s.s1.explain: ‘적으면 안 되다’ mean ‘must not be fewer.’ So adults >= children: more adults okay and same number okay, fewer adults no.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.prompt: Find 3 reservations wey follow every notice rule and aunt budget. a = adults, c = children.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.0: List rules as short conditions on a and c before trying numbers.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.1: Try one reservation and check every rule; if one fail, change a or c and check again.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.hint.2: Check cost last: 8,000 x a + 5,000 x c.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c1: 어린이는 1명 이상 있어야 합니다: need at least one child.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c2: 어른이 어린이보다 적으면 안 됩니다: adult count must not be less than child count.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c4: 6명 이하: no more than 6 people total.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.fail.c5: Total more than 40,000 won (8,000 per adult, 5,000 per child).
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.explain: Five reservations fit: (3 adults, 1 child) 29,000 won; (2, 2) 26,000 won; (4, 1) 37,000 won; (3, 2) 34,000 won; (3, 3) 39,000 won. Notice and message give limits, no be one exact order.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Choose ONE reservation and write polite Korean (-요) request to museum: number of adults, children and total cost.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Start with adult number, then children.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Say total last and end with -요.
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Numbers match one reservation I made?
n-k-k5-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Total right (8,000 each adult + 5,000 each child)?

n-k-k5-02.title: Hayun pass teacher words to somebody
n-k-k5-02.topic: Pass on person words without changing meaning
n-k-k5-02.goal: Compare relayed message with original, find lines wey change meaning, and fix using reported speech.
n-k-k5-02.material:
Teacher give announcement to class today (Tuesday). Hayun dey class. 민수 absent and ask her wetin teacher say, so Hayun text am same afternoon. (-대 / -래 mean ‘I heard that ...’: dem pass on another person words. 벼룩시장 = flea market.)

[선생님 말씀]
‘토요일 학교 벼룩시장은 비가 오면 체육관에서 합니다. 물건은 한 사람이 다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요. 가격표는 학교에서 준비하니까 안 만들어 와도 돼요. 아침 9시 30분까지 체육관에 물건을 가져다 놓으세요. 팔고 남은 물건은 집에 가져가세요. 참가 신청서는 목요일까지 내세요.’
n-k-k5-02.thinking.1: Tell a limit, requirement and permission apart
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.prompt: Hayun text must pass along exact teacher words. Some lines change meaning. Choose one.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.0: Read teacher message sentence by sentence and find matching Hayun line.
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.hint.1: For each pair compare numbers, days and whether meaning na ‘may,’ ‘must’ or ‘no need.’
n-k-k5-02.s.s1.explain: Lines 3, 5 and 7 wrong. Line 3 change ‘up to five’ (다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요) into ‘must sell five.’ Line 5 change 9:30 to 8:30. Line 7 change deadline from Thursday to Friday. Other lines match teacher.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.prompt: Which version of line 3 pass along wetin teacher say about number of items?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.0: Say teacher sentence about items in your own words first: is five maximum, minimum or exact amount?
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.hint.1: Test each choice against meaning and compare endings (-아/어야 하다 and -(으)ㄹ 수 있다).
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.b: This say you must sell exactly five. Teacher give limit, no be required number.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.c: 이상 change limit into minimum, opposite of ‘up to five.’
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.r.d: This say selling not allowed at all; teacher allow up to five.
n-k-k5-02.s.s2.explain: ‘다섯 개까지 팔 수 있어요’ (you may sell up to five) pass along as ‘다섯 개까지 팔 수 있대.’ Maximum, minimum and exact number all different.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.prompt: Write corrected line 5 (time to bring items) and line 7 (form deadline) in Korean as Hayun would text 민수 (same afternoon, reporting teacher words).
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.0: Copy numbers and day from teacher message, no be Hayun text.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.hint.1: Use reported speech (e.g. -대/-래 or -라고 했어), like correct lines.
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: My two sentences end like reported speech (-대/-래/-라고 했어)?
n-k-k5-02.s.s3.selfAssess.1: 민수 arrive on time and hand in form correct day?

n-k-k5-04.title: Which day deadline?
n-k-k5-04.goal: Read deadline message closely, choose question wey tell what you must do, and ask politely.
n-k-k5-04.material:
Today Monday, 11월 2일. Teacher send message to class chat.

선생님: ‘발표 자료는 금요일 전까지 메일로 보내 주세요. 파일 이름에는 이름을 꼭 써 주세요.’

You plan to finish slides Friday morning.
n-k-k5-04.thinking.1: Choose question wey fit change decision
n-k-k5-04.prereq.1: Don see 전에 / -까지 and polite/honorific speech to teacher
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.prompt: You plan finish slides Friday morning. Before deciding, which question most useful to ask teacher?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.0: Read deadline sentence slowly. Which word fit have two meanings?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.hint.1: Which question go change wetin you do Friday morning?
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.a: Number of slides no be issue; message leave another question open.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.b: Message already tell you wetin to write for file name.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.d: Today Monday 11월 2일, so Friday date already known (11월 6일).
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.r.e: This assume say Friday sending allowed. Na that message leave unclear.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.explain: ‘금요일 전까지’ fit mean ‘until day before Friday’ or ‘by Friday.’ Only teacher know which, so useful question ask whether Friday itself dey included.
n-k-k5-04.s.s1.acc.0: Teacher answer ‘by what time Friday’ fit settle practical details, but first question no confirm whether Friday allowed.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.prompt: Write your question to teacher in Korean (polite honorific). Mention deadline and clearly say wetin you wan confirm.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.0: Mention teacher deadline words, then say which day you no sure about.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.hint.1: Address teacher (선생님) and end with -요 or -ㅂ니다 speech.
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.0: My question show say I see two possible meanings?
n-k-k5-04.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Teacher fit answer with one short sentence?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.prompt: Teacher reply: ‘아, 금요일 오전 9시까지요.’ Why asking worth it?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.0: Compare wetin you assume before asking with answer you get.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.hint.1: Ask yourself: classmate fit reasonably understand message another way?
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.a: Teacher type wrong day and mean Wednesday.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.a: Nothing in message point to Wednesday, and reply give Friday deadline.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.b: Both Thursday and Friday fair readings, so only teacher fit settle am.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.c: ‘전까지’ always leave named day out, so Thursday last day.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.c: Answer show Friday morning allowed, and some speakers use ‘전까지’ loosely. E no be fixed rule.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.o.d: ‘까지’ always include named day, so Friday allowed from beginning.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.r.d: If that always true, no need ask; reply also add time (오전 9시) wey message never give.
n-k-k5-04.s.s3.explain: Same sentence fit mean ‘by Thursday’ or ‘by Friday.’ Reading only one way risk late file. Reply add time (오전 9시) wey message never give.

n-k-k5-05.title: From friends chat to elevator notice
n-k-k5-05.topic: audience wey no share your context
n-k-k5-05.goal: Rewrite chat message for strangers by adding information friends already know and changing speech style.
n-k-k5-05.material:
You and roommate dey hold housewarming (집들이) for flat 502호 next Saturday, 10월 24일, from 6 to 9 p.m. You write this to friends:

‘토욜 저녁에 우리집 파티함ㅋㅋ 좀 시끄러울 듯. 이해 ㄱㄱ’

(ㅋㅋ = laughing, ㄱㄱ = ‘go / okay’, 토욜 = 토요일.) Now you wan put notice in elevator for neighbours. Many older and you never meet most of dem.
n-k-k5-05.thinking.0: Judge wetin new reader no know
n-k-k5-05.thinking.1: Choose speech style for strangers of different ages
n-k-k5-05.prereq.1: Don see 양해, 죄송, 부탁 or fit learn from hints
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.prompt: Friends know where you live and when party happen. Neighbours wey never meet you no know. Which information elevator notice must add? Choose all.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.0: Imagine you read chat as neighbour: wetin you still no know?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.hint.1: Neighbours fit vex about noise. Wetin dem wan hear from you?
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.c: Wetin food and drinks dem go serve
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.r.c: Neighbours no need menu to understand notice.
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.o.e: Names of guests wey dey come
n-k-k5-05.s.s1.explain: Neighbours need know who dey make noise (which flat), for how long (start/end), and say you respect dem (apology/request). Menu and guests only matter to friends.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.prompt: Classmate write first notice draft. One line no fit strangers including older people. Choose am.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.0: Read each line as older neighbour. Which one sound like message to friend?
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.hint.1: Check how other requests for draft dey worded.
n-k-k5-05.s.s2.explain: Line 4 ask neighbours for something in plain casual friendly way (‘이해해 줘요’). For people you no know, ask with ‘주세요 / 주시면 감사하겠습니다’, e.g. ‘이해해 주시면 감사하겠습니다’.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.prompt: Now write full Korean notice yourself for elevator. Include flat, start/end time, apology or request for understanding. Use polite notice-style speech.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.0: Start with greeting and flat number, like real notice.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.hint.1: Put facts (when, wetin) in one sentence, apology in next.
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Neighbour wey never meet me know which flat and when party end?
n-k-k5-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: My request sound respectful to older person?
